asks.question: Pick the first decision that went wrong and who made it (their good play and execution are options too); add a note if it needs one. On a chance drop, also answer valid?: did our chances really get worse here?
asks.title: What went wrong first?
asks.why: Your tags pick the decisions we study next: the two or three that cost us the most goals and chances get compared against higher ranks, and you review those clips before anything goes to the team.

asks.question: valid? — does the moment show what the claim says? (no covers a wrong outcome too)
asks.title: Targets: is the number right?
asks.why: These metrics are what winning teams do more of. Answer once: when your answers agree, the metric is trusted and gets green or red in the session report, and it is not asked again unless its definition changes.

asks.question: valid? — does the moment show what the metric says?
asks.title: Is the number right?
asks.why: Six session-report metrics have no ballchasing equivalent; when your answers agree with what the moments show, each moves to reviewed and can carry advice in the report.
